lastCompletedStory.title: De-inline the /cam-prune and /cam-next templates to call the new CLI

nextStoryContext: US-004 de-inlined the remaining /cam-prune template. /cam-next was already de-inlined in US-003 as a direct side effect of folding the preflight into `cam next` itself (both dual copies already showed the 'Pre-flight Checks (deterministic, run by cam next itself)' section pointing at src/commands/next-preflight.ts before this story started -- verified via `diff -q` byte-identical, no edit needed there). This story's actual delta: .claude/commands/cam-prune.md + templates/commands/cam-prune.md replaced the imperative 7-step git dance (git status dirty-check, git branch --show-current, gh pr view confirmation, git checkout main / git pull origin main / git branch -D <branch> / git fetch --prune, print summary) with a call to `cam prune` (the deterministic CLI subcommand shipped in US-001, src/commands/prune.ts, runPrune/parsePruneArgs) plus narration guidance for each of its STOP paths (dirty tree, non-cam/* branch, open unmerged PR, already-on-main) mapped to the corresponding `--force` re-run advice. `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run to sync src/vendor/_generated.ts (templates/ rides the generic walkFiles path in scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts, not the curated FILES const -- same gotcha as US-003's cam-next.md edit). Both template pairs verified byte-identical post-edit via `diff -q`. No src/ or CLI-behavior changes in this story: `cam prune` itself was untouched, only the two command-prompt markdown files that narrate around it. If a future story needs to touch prune behavior, edit src/commands/prune.ts directly and remember its slash-command narration lives in the two dual-copy files touched here.
